title: KV cache and efficient autoregressive generation
description: Caching keys and values to avoid recomputation during decoding, cache memory formula, prefill vs decode, grouped-query attention.

title: Quantisation of weights and activations
description: Number formats, symmetric and asymmetric int8 quantisation with scale and zero point, per-tensor vs per-channel scales, rounding error and outliers.

title: Speculative decoding and mixture of experts
description: Draft-and-verify decoding with the accept/reject rule that preserves the target distribution, expected speed-up, and sparse expert routing.

title: Embeddings and vector similarity search
description: Text embeddings, cosine similarity, TF-IDF and BM25, exact vs approximate nearest neighbours (IVF, HNSW).

title: Retrieval-augmented generation
description: Chunking, hybrid retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion, reranking, the retrieve-then-generate pipeline and its failure modes.

title: Evaluating LLMs and RAG systems
description: Benchmarks and contamination, LLM judges, recall@k, MRR, nDCG, faithfulness, slices and bootstrap confidence intervals.

title: Research practice and controlled experiments
description: Reading papers, reproducing results, ablations, seeds and variance, paired comparisons and honest reporting.
